mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, left_bracket, field, compare, value, right_bracket, logic, rule_id, index, name, source_type
mapper.select: SELECT crc.id, crc.left_bracket, crc.field, crc.compare, crc.value, crc.right_bracket, crc.logic, crc.rule_id, crc.index, crc.name, cc.value_type FROM cfg_rule_condition AS crc LEFT JOIN cfg_condition AS cc ON cc.condition_field = crc.field AND cc.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE crc.is_deleted = FALSE and cc.rule_type = #{ruleType} order by crc.index
